# internal/libs/

This directory holds **pre-compiled native static libraries** used by CGO
when building axon with the `onnx` build tag.

## Contents (generated by build script)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `libtokenizers.a` | HuggingFace tokenizers FFI (from `daulet/tokenizers` releases) |

## How files get here

Run:
```bash
./scripts/build.sh --onnx
```

The script downloads a **pre-compiled** `libtokenizers.a` from the
`daulet/tokenizers` GitHub Releases — **no Rust toolchain required**.

**Do NOT commit `.a` files** — they are generated artifacts (~5MB).
They are listed in `.gitignore`.

## Supported platforms

| Platform | File downloaded from |
|----------|----------------------|
| macOS arm64 | `libtokenizers-aarch64-apple-darwin.a` |
| macOS amd64 | `libtokenizers-x86_64-apple-darwin.a` |
| Linux amd64 | `libtokenizers-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.a` |
| Linux arm64 | `libtokenizers-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.a` |
